newsitem.title: USA: Calif. positioned to expand trade role - economist.
newsitem.headline: Calif. positioned to expand trade role - economist.

text.p: California is positioned to increase exports, a key driver of the state's economic recovery, according DRI/McGraw-Hill's California economist.

"With continued interest and surging exports to (the) Pacific Rim, the state is literally well positioned to expand its trade role," economist Jay Kloepfer said during a panel discussion at a conference here.
Kloepfer said demand for industrial machinery, computers, electronics and transportation equipment has sparked the state's manufacturing sector.
"The Golden State can resume its lead in both the national and global economies," Kloepfer said. "However, it won't be the same economy, and it will not be at past levels."
DRI/McGraw-Hill is a unit of Standard & Poor's, which is a division of McGraw-Hill Cos Inc.
